recommendation.reason: This non-agentic benchmark reports 59.2% for its best listed model and has 104 citations over approximately 15 months.
risks: Agreement between the model judge and humans is not reported.
Reward hacking and shortcut defenses are not addressed.
Containerized execution and access to the model judge need to be established.
